game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall, a warm hearth hall: the frost mage must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall: a warm hearth hall
core_gameplay_loop: In Hearth Hall, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round, frozen golems strike the hearth fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the potions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the hearth fire from frozen golems in Hearth Hall: keep the potions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: potions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Hearth Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Hearth Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while potions > 0.
